excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

texts.zh:
星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。

现在，你们的“星海共同体”将由我们接管。欢庆吧。
texts.en:
Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

We will now be taking command of your 'Galactic Community'. Celebrations are warranted.

texts.zh: 远古失落帝国的碎片[assimilated_fe.GetName]被原主脑的一个更加强势的分支吸收。也许这对它是最好的结局。
texts.en: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, [assimilated_fe.GetName] has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

texts.zh:
即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了[From.GetSpeciesName]的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。

现在，[From.GetName]已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个泛星系防卫联盟的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并加入联盟来击退这一对星系中所有智慧生命造成威胁的敌人。
texts.en:
The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the [From.GetSpeciesName]. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.

Now, the [From.GetName] have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a Galactic Defense League and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

label.en: Will they be able to save us?
